novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，该方法将动态时序图建模为快照序列，通过图摘要压缩原图并输入图自编码器，利用重构误差训练节点表征，再通过循环神经网络学习时间维度的依赖关系，实现高效的大规模时序图表示学习。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method GSAERU based on graph summarization, which models dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots, compresses the original graph via graph summarization and feeds it into a graph autoencoder, trains node representations using reconstruction error, and then learns temporal dependencies through a recurrent neural network, enabling efficient large-scale sequential graph representation learning.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻上原图快照的序列
通过图摘要技术对原图进行压缩
将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器，利用与原图的重构误差训练原图节点的表征
通过循环神经网络学习原图在时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Model dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each moment
Compress the original graph through graph summarization technology
Input the compressed new graph into a graph autoencoder, and use the reconstruction error with the original graph to train representations of original graph nodes
Learn feature information and dependencies of the original graph in the time dimension through a recurrent neural network

novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，该算法采用领导-工作者模式，领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法划分原图，工作节点基于图摘要技术进行小批量训练，并通过注意力层返回结果，领导节点汇总计算梯度并同步更新所有计算节点模型，大大加速GNN训练并提升链路预测性能。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm DSGNN based on graph summarization, which adopts a leader-worker mode, where the leader partitions the original graph using a graph flow partitioning algorithm based on edge segmentation, workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology and return results through an attention layer, and the leader aggregates results and computes gradients to synchronously update models on all computing nodes, greatly accelerating GNN training and improving link prediction performance.
technical_features: 采用领导-工作者工作模式
领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回给领导节点
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: Leader node partitions the original graph using a graph flow partitioning algorithm based on edge segmentation
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology
Training results are returned to the leader through an attention layer
Leader node summarizes results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes

novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制，该机制统一利用图摘要技术压缩图结构以降低计算和内存开销，并针对时序图表示学习和分布式训练两种场景分别构建了GSAERU和DSGNN模型，实现了大规模动态图的高效处理。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed an optimization mechanism for graph neural networks on large-scale dynamic graphs, which uniformly utilizes graph summarization technology to compress graph structures for reducing computational and memory overhead, and constructs GSAERU and DSGNN models for sequential graph representation learning and distributed training respectively, achieving efficient processing of large-scale dynamic graphs.
technical_features: 利用图摘要技术压缩图结构以降低计算和内存开销
构建用于大规模时序图表示学习的GSAERU模型
构建用于分布式图神经网络优化训练的DSGNN模型
通过压缩后的图以自编码器或小批量训练方式进行高效的表示学习和训练
technical_features_en: Exploit graph summarization technology to compress graph structures to reduce computation and memory overhead
Construct GSAERU model for large-scale sequential graph representation learning
Construct DSGNN model for distributed graph neural network optimization training
Perform efficient representation learning and training on compressed graphs via autoencoder or mini-batch training
